# theme-404 spec

**Feature**: Scriptlog "blog" theme - 404 handling and template-level error behavior
**Generated by**: Playwright Planner Agent (per `prompts/11-master-playwright-planner.md`)
**App**: Scriptlog, PHP >= 7.4, MVC, Bootstrap 4, jQuery
**Bootstrap**: use `e2e/seed.spec.ts` and `playwright.config.js`
**Phase**: Plan section 5.2 Phase 1 - "No 404 in templates"

---

## Purpose

Guarantee that HTTP 404 / 400 are owned solely by the Dispatcher and that no template
hard-codes `http_response_code(404)`, `exit`, or `die`. A valid URL must render its
content; an invalid slug/identifier must produce a proper 404/400 page with a Back-to-Home
link, and never corrupt the HTML output (double `<html>`, broken header/footer).

---

## URLs

| Route | Expected |
|-------|----------|
| `/` | 200 |
| `/?p=11` (valid post) | 200, single template |
| `/?p=999999` (missing post) | 404 template, HTTP 404 |
| `/?p=12` (protected post) | 200, password form |
| `/nope-does-not-exist` | 404 template, HTTP 404 |
| `/download/{identifier}/file` (invalid id) | 400 page (no header corruption) |

Note: e2e runs with `permalink_setting: {rewrite: "no"}` so posts are query-string based.

---

## Preconditions

- `blogware_e2e` DB seeded with posts ID 11 (published), 12 (protected, password
  `e2e-secret`), plus at least 8 more published posts.
- App reachable at `baseURL` via Playwright `webServer`.
- UI language English for deterministic assertions.

---

## User Actions

- Open a valid post URL directly and confirm content renders.
- Open a bogus post ID and confirm the 404 page with a "Back to Home" link.
- Open a bogus download identifier and confirm the 400 page renders without corrupting the
  document (single `<html>`, header/footer intact).

---

## Expected Behaviour

- Valid single post returns HTTP 200 and renders `.post-single`.
- Missing post ID returns HTTP 404 and renders `h1.h4.sr-only` "404" plus a Back-to-Home
  link (`btn.btn-outline-primary.btn-lg`).
- The document has exactly one `<html>`, one `<header role="banner">`, one
  `<main id="main-content">`, one `<footer class="main-footer">` on every page including
  error pages.
- No `http_response_code`, `exit`, or `die` appear in any template file
  (`public/themes/blog/*.php`).

---

## Validation Rules

- `page.goto('/nope')` ends on URL containing `/nope` (no redirect loop) with status 404.
- Assert `locator('main h1, h1.sr-only')` contains "404" text.
- Assert the Back-to-Home link href resolves to the app URL root.

---

## Network Behaviour

- All error pages still load the CSS/JS asset bundle with 200 (no broken styling).
- No 5xx on any valid route.

---

## UI Components

- 404 template: `.page-wrap` `role="alert"`, `span.display-1`, `h1.h4.sr-only`,
  `a.btn.btn-outline-primary.btn-lg` (Back to Home).
- Standard header/nav/footer all present.

---

## Accessibility

- 404 message uses `aria-live="assertive"`.
- Back-to-Home link has visible text and a home icon.

---

## Console

- No uncaught JS errors on the 404 page load.

---

## Test Scenarios (prioritized)

Critical:
- Valid post ID renders single post (200).
- Missing post ID renders 404 (status 404) with Back-to-Home link.
- Document integrity: exactly one `<html>`, `<header>`, `<main>`, `<footer>` on 404 page.
- No `http_response_code(404)`/`exit`/`die` in any theme template.

High:
- Bogus download identifier returns a 400-class page without corrupting the document.

Regression:
- The same assertions must hold after the partials/ViewModel refactor.

---

## Notes for the Generator Agent

Generate `e2e/theme-404.spec.js`. Use `page.goto()` and assert `response().status()`, plus
`page.locator('html')` count via `page.locator('html')` single instance. Reference the
`404.php` template for exact class names. Run chromium/firefox/webkit.
